# Digital Signal Processing

## Chapter 1 Discrete-Time Signals

digital signal processing dsp deals with discrete time signals and systems.
The discrete fourier transform dft converts a finite sequence into its
frequency domain representation, computed efficiently with the fft algorithm.
Sampling a continuous signal yields a discrete time sequence.

## Chapter 2 DFT and FFT

the dft of a length N sequence requires N^2 operations while the fft
reduces this to N log N. Windowing is applied before the dft to reduce
spectral leakage in practical spectrum analysis.
